content: The main focus of this paper is to apply domain adaptation for SQA. In this approach, we have two SQA models (QANets), one trained from target domain data (ASR hypotheses) and another trained from source domain data (reference transcriptions). Because the two domains share common information, some layers in these two models can be tied in order to model the shared features. Hence, we can choose whether each layer in the QA model should be shared. Tying the weights between the source layer and the target layer in order to learn a symmetric mapping is to project both source and target domain data to a shared common space. Different combinations will be investigated in our experiments.
